newsitem.title: USA: US crudes break to firm numbers, sweets pressured.
newsitem.headline: US crudes break to firm numbers, sweets pressured.

text.p: U.S. crudes broke higher Tuesday on technical buying in the futures market, while key sweet grades failed to sustain morning gains due to a widening West Texas Intermediate-Brent spread, traders said.
Uncertainty over the course of outright prices, and settling of foreign crudes delivered against the NYMEX for May, have leant support to most grade differentials.
But, expansion of June WTI-Brent spreads on Tuesday to more than $1.75 in favor of June WTI, opened the arbitrage window for increased flows of North Sea Brent for U.S. Gulf delivery, traders said.
